description.value:
Tygers never forgive, and never forget. After the death of Shinobu the Second in the late 2040s at the hands of a still-unidentified sharpshooter, the Nakagawa Foundation relaxed its typically strict purse strings. These allotted funds were used to contract a few clandestine workshops for the design and creation of a specialized sniper rifle for ‘security consultants’ of the corporation — meaning, the Tyger Claws. While the M25 Masakado isn’t a tank killer nor especially fast, it’s more accurate and effective than most give it credit for, leaving it to be often underestimated. Which is exactly how the Tygers designed it to be.

Cost: 1,200eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Scout Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 5 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Long Scope, Silencer, Sniper Scout Barrel, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: After this weapon is fired, an Action is required to work its bolt before it can be fired again.

Range: Scout Rifle
Pre-installed: Long Scope, Silencer, Sniper Scout Barrel, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
